name: macon170-cms
description: Pack 170's isolated SonicJS content management backend

scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --var APP_VERSION:$(git rev-parse HEAD)
scripts.deploy:dry: wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc --var APP_VERSION:$(git rev-parse HEAD)
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply macon170-cms --remote --config wrangler.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply macon170-cms --remote --config wrangler.custom-migrations.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply macon170-cms --local --config wrangler.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply macon170-cms --local --config wrangler.custom-migrations.jsonc
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute macon170-cms --local --config wrangler.jsonc --file scripts/seed-local-roster.sql
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:migrations && bun run test:migrations:signups
